_purpose: Known issues of the data, loaded into ledger_issue. 'caveat' is the one-line note the chatbot attaches to an answer that reads an affected table or column; 'affects' lists mart tables or columns (table.column).

issues.title: The dataset is synthetic
issues.detail: KPCL_GMS_10yr.xlsx is a synthetic 10-year dataset built around real figures read from the K-eRP document. Only the anchored slices (anchor_scope column) are real: RTPS and SGS unit figures on 06-Apr-2025, RTPS and SGS March-2025 totals and RTPS FY 2024-25 totals. Everything else is generated.
issues.caveat: These figures come from a synthetic POC dataset; only the RTPS/SGS figures pinned to the K-eRP reports are real.

issues.title: Hydro major/minor split differs from the HO dashboard
issues.detail: projects.plant_category puts 14 hydro stations in MAJOR HYDRO; the HO dashboard counts only SGS, NPH and VUGPH. On hold until KPCL confirms the split.
issues.caveat: Major/minor hydro here follows the dataset (14 major stations), not the HO dashboard (3 major stations).

issues.title: Only part of the document is reproduced
issues.detail: Not reconciled to the document: the other 31 stations' 06-Apr-2025 figures, April-2025 month-to-date, the grid row, coal stock, dam levels, the sale-of-energy bill and the JMR anchors.

issues.title: RTPS coal stock vs unit coal on 06-Apr-2025
issues.detail: The reconcile stage writes the document's RTPS unit coal (20,572 t) for 06-Apr-2025, but the coal-stock table keeps the workbook's 18,470 t consumed that day.
issues.caveat: On 06-Apr-2025 RTPS unit coal (document) and the coal-stock ledger (dataset) differ.

issues.title: Billing, JMR, commercial, DMS, hourly and common-aux data are empty
issues.detail: Those schema areas exist in core_* but the workbook has no data for them; the mart does not expose them and the chatbot says so.

issues.title: Extreme daily ratios on near-zero generation days
issues.detail: 443 unit-days have heat rate or specific oil far outside the normal range because a few kWh were generated while fuel was burnt (flagged is_ratio_outlier). Weighted (sum/sum) metrics are unaffected.

issues.title: PAF rounded below PLF on 2 unit-days
issues.detail: The workbook stores PAF to two decimals, so declared capacity came out below gross on RTPS-U4 2022-07-19 and YTPS-U1 2017-03-30. Declared capacity is lifted to at least the day's gross generation.

issues.title: RTPS cumulative anchors look shifted by one unit
issues.detail: document_anchors.json gives RTPS 'U2' cum_gen 46,966, 'U3' 49,827.026, 'U4' 45,449.249; the workbook's opening balances reproduce these for U1, U2 and U3 instead (U1 has been out since 2022, so its cumulative is constant). The anchors' U1 row also shows 6,404 running hours for a unit that was out all year. Cumulative figures are not reconciled.
issues.caveat: Life-to-date figures for RTPS units 1-4 have not been checked against the K-eRP report.

issues.title: Second workbook not loaded
issues.detail: KPCL_33_Projects_10Y_Joint_Meter_and_MPR.xlsx uses different station names and capacities and a different generation level, so it is registered in src_file but not loaded.

issues.title: FY 2025-26 is partial
issues.detail: The data ends 30-Apr-2025, so FY 2025-26 and water year 2025-26 contain April 2025 only (water year 2024-25 runs to May 2025 and is also one month short).

issues.title: Reconcile sets RTPS planned/RSD hours to 0 on 06-Apr-2025
issues.detail: When the document's running hours are written for 06-Apr-2025, forced outage hours = 24 - running and planned/RSD hours are set to 0 so that hours still add to 24 (the SQLite core enforces the rule as a CHECK).
